_: Everything about how the dashboard looks lives here. Edit, save, reload the page. There is no build step. Delete this file and the defaults come back.
name: Your AI
_regions: Memories are grouped into bands on the sphere. `types` matches the START of a memory's type, so 'feedback' also catches 'feedback_rule'. The last region is the fallback for anything unmatched. Add, remove or rename freely: the legend, the colours and the filters all follow this list.
_colors: The whole palette. `accent` is the core and the highlights, `pulse` is the current that runs when a memory is recalled.
_links: Optional shortcuts in the side rail, to anything you want reachable from here. Left empty the section does not appear at all.
_showMachines: Draw a node for each machine that has recalled recently, with the current running from it to the memory it used. Needs the recall pulse log; harmless when there is none.
